releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.211: Diary Lock PIN prompt now has a Cancel button that returns to Diary → Me without changing the PIN or disabling the lock. Note cards use one ⭐ Favourite button, and long-press offers Favourite Karo / Favourite Hataayein. Includes Web Updates 380 and 381. Existing notes, photos, PINs, locks, Favourite Notes read mode, and Home Screen Widget features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 381: Note Pin button is replaced with a single ⭐ Favourite button. Long-pressing a note now offers Favourite Karo / Favourite Hataayein. Existing notes and saved data are preserved.
